predict.question: A population spreads from one cell: each round, every reached cell reaches two more, for two rounds. Only a fragment of 3 cells is accessible. How many cells count as reached?

exploreHint: Compare both named cases and inspect what changes.
bookIdea: Habitat isolation can matter in addition to total habitat area.
modelBoundary: The large component permits {A}; the accessible fragment caps reach at {B}. Component sizes are supplied premises, not inferred from a geographic map.
doesItHoldUp: Does it hold up? This is a capped tree, not animal movement, general habitat connectivity or extinction risk.
